text: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend seven candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel – Property Standards Committee : 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-196 Candidate PSC2-216 Candidate PSC2-158 Candidate PSC2-215 Candidate PSC2-150 Candidate PSC2-214 Candidate PSC2-175 Candidate PSC2-208 Candidate PSC2-183 Candidate PSC2-146 Candidate PSC2-193 Candidate PSC2-191 Candidate PSC2-213 Candidate PSC2-211 Candidate PSC2-177 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (August 25, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
